pretreatments.description: Chemo-mechanical pretreatment using NaOH (pH 10) combined with an ultrasonic disperser (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax Digital) at specific energy levels of 4544 kJ/kg TS, applied to waste activated sludge (WAS) from Aavin dairy effluent treatment plant at Ambathur, Chennai for 15–180 minutes.

Chemo-mechanical pretreatment using KOH (pH 10 or 11) combined with an ultrasonic disperser (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax Digital) at specific energy levels of 4544 kJ/kg TS, applied to waste activated sludge (WAS) for 15–180 minutes.

Chemo-mechanical pretreatment using Ca(OH)_2 (pH 8–11) combined with an ultrasonic disperser (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax Digital) at specific energy levels of 4544 kJ/kg TS, applied to waste activated sludge (WAS) for 15–180 minutes.

Control treatment without pretreatment, consisting of raw dairy waste activated sludge (WAS) sampled from the Aavin dairy effluent treatment plant at Ambathur, Chennai, characterized by a total COD of 10200 mg/L, total solids of 13850 mg/L, and pH of 6.97, before any chemical or mechanical treatment.
